pages.text: $(bold)Hoppers$() pull and pass items (lock one with a signal to gate flow). $(italic)Quark$() adds the $(bold)Chute$() — a one-block hopper that simply drops items straight through — and $(bold)Copper Pipes$() that push items along a line when pulsed, with encased variants to hide the run.
pages.title: Moving Items

pages.text: For factory-scale logistics — funnels, belts, the package network — see the $(italic)Create Compendium$(). For penned-animal automation, the $(italic)Traveler's Companion$() covers the $(bold)Feeding Trough$().
pages.title: Bigger Logistics
